title: gameboy's awesome mod additions
description: a mod that adds items and blocks nobody wanted or needed
body:
# gameboy's awesome mod additions
### what is this mod??
this is a mod that adds the most random things imaginable, from various berries to hammers that make you a literal god.

also adds a new type of ore! not sure if it's really useful for anything, but it's there and it can spawn in your world.

![A Minecraft Inventory tab showing modded items including various berries and tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/938f5beb56282a2ffe998b54902b4a61f4d60f8c.png)
### what the mod does
- adds a bunch of craftable berries that give you effects
  - speed berries: gives you a bunch of speed for a minute
  - condensed speed berries: 2x the effects of speed berries, also why would you crush 2 berries together
  - jump berries: gives you a lot of jump height for a minute
  - defense berries: gives you some defensive effects like regeneration and resistance
  - healing berries: gives you some strong regeneration for a minute
  - EVIL berries: they're pure evil
  - ultimate berries: yeah you're gonna have to play this mod to find out yourself (its every effect from nearly all berries combined)
- adds a new ore called Deeninium
  - dont ask where the name is from
  - you can smelt it
  - i did not add any utilty to this one at all
  - you can craft EVIL berries with it though
- and more!

all items (excluding testing items) are craftable!
  
### disclaimers
this mod was primarily made for hack club's [Hackcraft](https://hackcraft.hackclub.com/) program, so this mod may not be maintained or receive updates.

i don't recommend this mod if you're looking for a fully fleshed out mod, or if you're looking for a survival mod, as this mod just adds some silly additions and may be unbalanced at times.

if you're making a youtube video or something similar on this mod, please put the mod link in it's description! thank you!
